nodes.description: Address of the current contract owner, set to msg.sender in the Owned constructor and changed by transferOwnership/acceptOwnership.
Pending owner address staged by transferOwnership and consumed by acceptOwnership.
ERC20 token symbol, set to 'DONC' in the constructor.
ERC20 token name, set to 'Double or Nothing Coin' in the constructor.
ERC20 token decimals, set to 18 in the constructor.
Total token supply, minted to the deployer address in the constructor.
Mapping of token holder balances, mutated by transfer and transferFrom.
Nested allowance mapping owner=>spender=>amount, mutated by approve and approveAndCall.
Overflow-checked addition helper used by transfer and transferFrom.
Underflow-checked subtraction helper used by transfer and transferFrom.
Overflow-checked multiplication helper, unused by the token logic.
Division helper with zero-divisor guard, unused by the token logic.
Constructor that assigns contract ownership to msg.sender.
onlyOwner function that stages a new owner address in newOwner.
Completes ownership handover; requires msg.sender to equal newOwner.
Token constructor: sets symbol/name/decimals, mints total supply to a fixed address and emits Transfer.
Returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)].
Returns the balance of a given token owner.
Moves tokens from msg.sender to a recipient using SafeMath helpers.
Sets the allowance of spender for msg.sender and emits Approval.
Moves tokens from an owner to a recipient, deducting the caller allowance with SafeMath.
Returns the remaining allowance a spender has over a token owner.
Sets allowance then invokes receiveApproval on the spender contract inside the same transaction.
Payable fallback that unconditionally reverts, rejecting plain ETH transfers.
onlyOwner rescue function performing an external call to an arbitrary ERC20 token contract.
Caller-controlled address used for authorization, balance indexing and as argument to external calls.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data) executing untrusted spender code.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) on an attacker-supplied token address.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the indexed balance holder debited in transfer.
msg.sender is the allowance owner written in approve.
msg.sender indexes the spender allowance in transferFrom.
msg.sender is stored as allowance owner and forwarded to the external receiveApproval call.
msg.sender must equal owner through the onlyOwner modifier before the rescue transfer executes.
The Owned constructor assigns ownership directly from msg.sender.
transferOwnership is gated by onlyOwner which compares msg.sender to owner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender to equal the staged newOwner address.
msg.sender is passed as an argument into the untrusted spender contract call in approveAndCall.
Recipient parameter feeds the credited balance in transfer.
Amount parameter feeds the SafeMath debit/credit in transfer.
Spender parameter indexes the allowance mapping in approve.
Amount parameter is written into the allowance mapping in approve.
from parameter is debited in transferFrom.
to parameter is credited in transferFrom.
Amount parameter drives the balance and allowance debits in transferFrom.
Spender parameter receives the allowance and is the target of the external call.
Amount parameter is written to allowed and forwarded to the callee.
Caller-supplied data bytes flow through approveAndCall.
Arbitrary data is forwarded into the external receiveApproval callback.
tokenOwner parameter indexes the balances mapping in balanceOf.
tokenOwner parameter indexes the allowed mapping in allowance.
spender parameter indexes the allowed mapping in allowance.
tokenAddress parameter selects the contract invoked by the external call.
tokens parameter is passed as the amount for the external ERC20 transfer.
_newOwner parameter is stored into the newOwner state variable.
transfer writes the debited and credited balances.
approve writes the allowance mapping.
transferFrom updates both source and destination balances.
transferFrom decrements the spender allowance.
approveAndCall writes the allowance before the external call.
Constructor sets owner to msg.sender.
transferOwnership stages the new owner address.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner to owner.
acceptOwnership clears the staged newOwner address.
Constructor initialises the token symbol.
Constructor initialises the token name.
Constructor initialises decimals.
Constructor mints the fixed total supply.
Constructor assigns the whole supply to the deployer address.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply.
totalSupply subtracts balances[address(0)].
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
Queried balance is returned through the named local.
Remaining allowance is returned through the named local.
External call result is returned through the named success local.
transfer delegates balance addition to SafeMath.safeAdd.
transfer delegates balance subtraction to SafeMath.safeSub.
transferFrom delegates balance addition to SafeMath.safeAdd.
transferFrom delegates balance and allowance subtraction to SafeMath.safeSub.
approveAndCall unconditionally executes an external call to the spender contract after writing state, enabling reentrant behaviour.
The spender's receiveApproval implementation re-enters the token contract through the callback invocation.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call on an arbitrary token address, allowing reentrant control flow for owner-callable rescue.
